tokens.name: bg-page
tokens.usage: Page ground behind the three panes; the call transcript scrolls on it.

tokens.name: bg-surface
tokens.usage: Panes, cards, top bar, composer. The ground for most text.

tokens.name: bg-subtle
tokens.usage: Segmented-control track, avatar tiles, quiet fills, hairline dividers between rows.

tokens.name: bg-selected
tokens.usage: Selected queue row, Mochi's draft box at rest.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Titles, names, primary button fill, the selected-row edge. On bg-surface, bg-page and bg-subtle.

tokens.name: ink-body
tokens.usage: Transcript lines, brief text, draft text. On bg-surface and bg-selected.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Query line in a call row, Mochi's 'already did' list, quiet links. On bg-surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Section labels, timestamps, counts, hints. On bg-surface, bg-page and bg-subtle (at least 5.3:1 in light).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Decorative only: breadcrumb slash, neutral status dots. Fails 4.5:1; never for words.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text on an ink fill (primary button, your initials tile).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Pane dividers, card outlines, event-line rules.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Secondary button and input outlines. Kept from the reference: under 3:1, so a control's label or placeholder must carry it, never the outline alone.

tokens.name: border-dashed
tokens.usage: The dashed outline of a 'needs your ear' box: work Mochi could not finish.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid. At least 3:1 on every surface in every theme.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Alarm signal, the urgent ping, P1 and time-running-out text. On bg-surface (6.4:1).

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Warning signal text and time getting short. Same amber family as warning-dot. On bg-surface (6.3:1) and bg-page (6.0:1). A word, never a fill.

tokens.name: warning-dot
tokens.usage: Status dot for 'Needs you' rows. A mark, not text.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Check marks, 'Done' hints on finished Mochi actions.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of a confirmed verdict chip and a finished Mochi action.

tokens.name: success-border
tokens.usage: Outline of a confirmed chip and a finished Mochi action.

tokens.name: success-ink
tokens.usage: Words inside a confirmed chip, on success-bg.

tokens.name: ring-fill
tokens.usage: The team's goal ring while it fills (TodayRing on a ticket desk). Pastel green, never Mochi's colour; the ring turns success when it closes. About 3.2:1 on white for a graphic; the ring's words carry the meaning.

tokens.name: agent-sky
tokens.usage: Mochi's working colour: its core at rest in the desk, the 'with Mochi' ring, Mochi's event dots, the action fill. Never text.

tokens.name: agent-ube
tokens.usage: Mochi thinking: analysing, ranking, drafting. Core colour and the second aura glow.

tokens.name: agent-sakura
tokens.usage: Mochi idle, listening and speaking core.

tokens.name: agent-yuzu
tokens.usage: Mochi curious: unsure, wants the agent's judgement.

tokens.name: agent-matcha
tokens.usage: Mochi done: queue cleared, verdict confirmed. Also the 'always on' dot.

tokens.name: agent-hojicha
tokens.usage: Mochi sorry: a transcription or pipeline step failed.

tokens.name: agent-anzu
tokens.usage: Mochi handing a call over to the agent.

tokens.name: mochi-ink-sakura
tokens.usage: Mood word ('sakura') beside Mochi when idle, listening or speaking. On bg-surface.

tokens.name: mochi-ink-yuzu
tokens.usage: Mood word when curious.

tokens.name: mochi-ink-ube
tokens.usage: Mood word when thinking.

tokens.name: mochi-ink-matcha
tokens.usage: Mood word when done.

tokens.name: mochi-ink-hojicha
tokens.usage: Mood word when sorry.

tokens.name: mochi-ink-anzu
tokens.usage: Mood word when handing over.

tokens.name: mochi-skin
tokens.usage: Mochi's body. Desk (light, dark) is a cool rice white; warm is the brand's cream.

tokens.name: mochi-shade
tokens.usage: Mochi's lower edge, the far end of the body gradient.

tokens.name: mochi-highlight
tokens.usage: The light spot on Mochi's top-left.

tokens.name: mochi-skin-sorry
tokens.usage: Mochi's body when sorry: a little greyer, a little flatter.

tokens.name: mochi-shade-sorry
tokens.usage: Lower edge when sorry.

tokens.name: aura-sky
tokens.usage: Glow at the top-left of Mochi's own surfaces: the brief header, the island's working edge, the drafting border. Never for anything the agent or the system says.

tokens.name: aura-ube
tokens.usage: The second glow on Mochi's own surfaces, bottom-right of the brief header and in the island's working edge.

tokens.name: shimmer-a
tokens.usage: Skeleton line while Mochi drafts: base.

tokens.name: shimmer-b
tokens.usage: Skeleton line: the moving light.

tokens.name: island-bg
tokens.usage: Mochi Island's fill. Always dark, in every theme, so the island reads as one object that floats above the desk.

tokens.name: island-ink
tokens.usage: Text and primary button fill on island-bg.

tokens.name: island-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on island-bg (7:1).

tokens.name: island-alarm
tokens.usage: The words 'New alarm' and the flagged-moment marker on island-bg. Always paired with words.

tokens.name: island-line
tokens.usage: The island's hairline edge and its secondary button fill.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Call subject at the top of the call pane.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Transcript lines, brief text, row text.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Names in queue rows, panel titles.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Section labels in Mochi's brief: 'What happened', 'Mochi already'.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: The greeting's headline: what needs the agent today ('3 tickets to tag').

styles.name: noticed
styles.usage: Mochi's noticed sentence on the ticket desk, the one line to read before anything else; its key in 600.
styles.sample: Their 7th request about Closure since 25 Aug.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Timestamps, call IDs, durations, counts, raw system values.

styles.name: data-strong
styles.usage: Counts in the top bar ('42 need you').

styles.name: data-xs
styles.usage: The percentage beside a Confidence word.

styles.name: mochi-wordmark
styles.usage: The word 'mochi' as a name. Lowercase, never with a logo.

styles.name: mochi-mood
styles.usage: Mochi's mood word ('sakura', 'ube') beside it on its home screen.

styles.name: state-label
styles.usage: Uppercase state label on Mochi's home ('THINKING').

styles.name: bubble
styles.usage: Mochi's speech bubble on its home screen.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Landing hero headline only. Two lines at most.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Landing section headings. Two lines at most.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: Landing sub-lines under a display heading, in ink-muted.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Segmented-control track padding, gap between confidence segments.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between lines inside a row.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Gap between list items in the brief, chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons, dot-to-text gap.

tokens.name: space-2.5
tokens.usage: Gap between avatar and message.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Queue row padding (vertical), card inner padding.

tokens.name: space-3.5
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of md buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Queue row padding (horizontal), gap between transcript lines, brief section padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Brief section padding (horizontal), call pane vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Call pane horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Mochi home screen side padding.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Confidence segments.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, tags, avatar tiles, segmented options.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, the draft box, the composer, the segmented track.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Mode buttons on Mochi's home.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Mochi's speech bubble (with a 4px tail corner).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status dots, the live dot.

tokens.name: shadow-seg
tokens.usage: The selected option in a segmented control.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Pickers and menus that float over the call pane.

tokens.name: shadow-mochi
tokens.usage: Mochi at small sizes, so it sits on the surface.

tokens.name: layout-topbar
tokens.usage: Top bar height.

tokens.name: layout-queue
tokens.usage: Queue pane width (left).

tokens.name: layout-brief
tokens.usage: Mochi's brief pane width (right).

tokens.name: layout-greeting
tokens.usage: Widest the MochiGreeting card grows, so its lines stay readable on a wide ticket pane.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Height of pane-level buttons (Confirm all, Escalate).

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Height of buttons inside cards and segmented options.

tokens.name: mochi-rest
tokens.usage: Mochi's resting silhouette, as a border-radius. Every Mochi, at every size, starts here.
